headline: Oil Corridor Fragility Is Repricing European Inflation Risk Faster Than Consensus Admits

market_belief: Market consensus expects continued disinflation and stable energy pass-through.
what_is_happening: Routing fragility and policy asymmetry keep upside oil risk alive despite short-term spot calm.
incentives: European policymakers seek price stability before political cycles
second_order_effects: Higher transport costs feed core inflation lag
Rates volatility rises as policy path confidence falls
retail_positioning: Stage entries via broad energy ETF exposure
Pair with defensive hedge into macro data windows
